ingredients.name: Palm Oil
ingredients.summary: Palm oil is a common cooking oil derived from the fruit of oil palms.
ingredients.details: While palm oil is widely used, its production is associated with environmental concerns. It is high in saturated fats, which can impact heart health if consumed in large quantities.

ingredients.name: Canola Oil
ingredients.summary: Canola oil is a vegetable oil derived from rapeseed.
ingredients.details: Canola oil is low in saturated fat and contains omega-3 fatty acids, making it a heart-healthy option when used in moderation.

ingredients.name: Soy Lecithin
ingredients.summary: Soy lecithin is an emulsifier derived from soybeans.
ingredients.details: It is commonly used to stabilize and blend ingredients. Generally considered safe, but those with soy allergies should avoid it.

ingredients.name: Wheat Flour
ingredients.summary: Wheat flour is a powder made from grinding wheat.
ingredients.details: It contains gluten, which can be problematic for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.summary: Sugar is a sweetener derived from sugar cane or sugar beets.
ingredients.details: Excessive consumption of sugar can lead to health issues such as obesity, diabetes, and tooth decay.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.summary: Salt is a mineral composed primarily of sodium chloride.
ingredients.details: High sodium intake is linked to increased blood pressure and heart disease risk. Moderation is key.

ingredients.name: Corn Starch
ingredients.summary: Corn starch is a carbohydrate extracted from corn.
ingredients.details: It is used as a thickening agent in cooking and is generally considered safe.

ingredients.name: Spices
ingredients.summary: Spices are aromatic substances used to flavor food.
ingredients.details: They are generally safe and can provide health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory properties.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.summary: Garlic is a bulbous plant used for flavoring.
ingredients.details: Garlic is known for its health benefits, including potential cardiovascular benefits and immune support.

ingredients.name: Whole Milk Powder
ingredients.summary: Whole milk powder is dehydrated milk with fat content.
ingredients.details: It contains lactose and dairy proteins, which can be problematic for those with lactose intolerance or dairy allergies.

ingredients.name: Skim Milk Powder
ingredients.summary: Skim milk powder is dehydrated milk with reduced fat content.
ingredients.details: Similar to whole milk powder, it contains lactose and dairy proteins, posing issues for those with lactose intolerance or dairy allergies.

ingredients.name: Caramel Color
ingredients.summary: Caramel color is a food coloring made by heating sugar.
ingredients.details: Some types of caramel color may contain 4-MEI, a potential carcinogen, but it is generally considered safe in food use.

ingredients.name: Monosodium Glutamate
ingredients.summary: Monosodium glutamate (MSG) is a flavor enhancer.
ingredients.details: While generally recognized as safe, some people report sensitivity to MSG, experiencing symptoms like headaches and nausea.

ingredients.name: Defatted Soybean
ingredients.summary: Defatted soybean is soy flour with most of the oil removed.
ingredients.details: It is used as a protein source and is generally safe, but should be avoided by those with soy allergies.

ingredients.name: Yeast Extract
ingredients.summary: Yeast extract is a flavoring derived from yeast.
ingredients.details: It is used to enhance savory flavors and is generally considered safe.

ingredients.name: Natural and Artificial Flavors
ingredients.summary: These are substances added to food to impart flavor.
ingredients.details: While natural flavors are derived from natural sources, artificial flavors are synthetically created. Both are generally safe, but some individuals may prefer to avoid artificial additives.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.summary: Honey is a natural sweetener produced by bees.
ingredients.details: It contains natural sugars and antioxidants, but should be consumed in moderation due to its high sugar content.

ingredients.name: Dextrin
ingredients.summary: Dextrin is a carbohydrate derived from starch.
ingredients.details: It is used as a thickening agent and is generally considered safe.

ingredients.name: Pasteurized Milk
ingredients.summary: Pasteurized milk is milk that has been heat-treated to kill bacteria.
ingredients.details: It is safe for most people but contains lactose, which can be problematic for those with lactose intolerance.

ingredients.name: Cheese Cultures
ingredients.summary: Cheese cultures are bacteria used in cheese production.
ingredients.details: They are essential for cheese fermentation and are generally safe.

ingredients.name: Enzymes
ingredients.summary: Enzymes are proteins that catalyze biochemical reactions.
ingredients.details: Used in food processing, they are generally safe and help in digestion and fermentation processes.

ingredients.name: Onion Flake
ingredients.summary: Onion flake is dehydrated onion used for flavoring.
ingredients.details: It is a natural ingredient used to impart onion flavor and is generally safe.

ingredients.name: Onion Extract
ingredients.summary: Onion extract is a concentrated form of onion flavor.
ingredients.details: It is used to enhance flavor and is generally considered safe.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.summary: Soy sauce is a liquid condiment made from fermented soybeans, wheat, and salt.
ingredients.details: It contains gluten and high sodium levels, which can be a concern for those with gluten intolerance or high blood pressure.

ingredients.name: Tomato Powder
ingredients.summary: Tomato powder is dehydrated tomato used for flavoring.
ingredients.details: It is a natural ingredient used to impart tomato flavor and is generally safe.

ingredients.name: Dried Onion
ingredients.summary: Dried onion is dehydrated onion used for flavoring.
ingredients.details: It is a natural ingredient used to impart onion flavor and is generally safe.

ingredients.name: Glucose
ingredients.summary: Glucose is a simple sugar used as a sweetener.
ingredients.details: It is a source of energy but can contribute to high blood sugar levels if consumed in excess.

ingredients.name: Sucrose Fatty Acid Esters
ingredients.summary: Sucrose fatty acid esters are emulsifiers made from sugar and fatty acids.
ingredients.details: They are used to stabilize food products and are generally considered safe.

ingredients.name: Dextrose Anhydrous Glucose
ingredients.summary: Dextrose anhydrous is a form of glucose used as a sweetener.
ingredients.details: It is a simple sugar that can raise blood sugar levels if consumed in large quantities.

ingredients.name: Banana
ingredients.summary: Banana is a fruit used for flavor and nutrition.
ingredients.details: It is a natural ingredient rich in potassium and generally safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Processed Honey
ingredients.summary: Processed honey is honey that has been filtered and pasteurized.
ingredients.details: It retains the natural sweetness of honey but may lose some beneficial enzymes during processing.

ingredients.name: Tomato Paste
ingredients.summary: Tomato paste is a concentrated form of tomatoes used for flavoring.
ingredients.details: It is a natural ingredient used to impart tomato flavor and is generally safe.

ingredients.name: Fermented Milk
ingredients.summary: Fermented milk is milk that has been fermented with lactic acid bacteria.
ingredients.details: It is used in products like yogurt and kefir and is generally safe, but contains lactose.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.summary: Citric acid is a natural acid found in citrus fruits used as a preservative and flavoring.
ingredients.details: It is generally considered safe and is used to add a sour taste to foods and beverages.

ingredients.name: Mono- and Diglycerides
ingredients.summary: Mono- and diglycerides are emulsifiers used to blend ingredients.
ingredients.details: They are generally considered safe and are used to improve texture and shelf life of food products.

ingredients.name: Processed with Alkali
ingredients.summary: Processed with alkali refers to the treatment of cocoa with an alkaline solution.
ingredients.details: This process, also known as Dutch processing, reduces acidity and darkens the color of cocoa, and is generally safe.

ingredients.name: Soy Protein Hydrolysate
ingredients.summary: Soy protein hydrolysate is a form of soy protein that has been broken down into smaller peptides.
ingredients.details: It is used as a protein source and is generally safe, but should be avoided by those with soy allergies.

ingredients.name: Apple Puree
ingredients.summary: Apple puree is a smooth mixture of cooked apples used for flavor and sweetness.
ingredients.details: It is a natural ingredient and is generally safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Maltose
ingredients.summary: Maltose is a sugar made from two glucose molecules.
ingredients.details: It is used as a sweetener and can contribute to high blood sugar levels if consumed in excess.

ingredients.name: Whey Powder
ingredients.summary: Whey powder is a dairy product made from the liquid remaining after milk has been curdled and strained.
ingredients.details: It is a source of protein but contains lactose, which can be problematic for those with lactose intolerance.

ingredients.name: Garlic Flake
ingredients.summary: Garlic flake is dehydrated garlic used for flavoring.
ingredients.details: It is a natural ingredient used to impart garlic flavor and is generally safe.

ingredients.name: Paprika Color
ingredients.summary: Paprika color is a natural coloring derived from paprika.
ingredients.details: It is used to add color to food products and is generally considered safe.

ingredients.name: Disodium Inosinate
ingredients.summary: Disodium inosinate is a flavor enhancer often used with MSG.
ingredients.details: It is generally recognized as safe, but some individuals may experience sensitivity to flavor enhancers.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.summary: Sugar is a common sweetener used in many food products.
ingredients.details: Excessive consumption of sugar can lead to health issues such as obesity, diabetes, and heart disease. It is important to consume sugar in moderation.

ingredients.name: Bleached Wheat Flour
ingredients.summary: Bleached wheat flour is flour that has been chemically treated to improve its baking qualities.
ingredients.details: The bleaching process can remove some nutrients from the flour, and it may contain chemical residues. It is often used in processed foods.

ingredients.name: Malted Barley Flour
ingredients.summary: Malted barley flour is made from barley that has been allowed to sprout before being dried and ground.
ingredients.details: It is used to enhance flavor and improve the texture of baked goods. It is generally considered safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Niacin
ingredients.summary: Niacin, also known as vitamin B3, is a nutrient that helps convert food into energy.
ingredients.details: It is essential for maintaining healthy skin, nerves, and digestion. Niacin is often added to foods to fortify them.

ingredients.name: Reduced Iron
ingredients.summary: Reduced iron is a form of iron used to fortify foods.
ingredients.details: Iron is an essential mineral that helps transport oxygen in the blood. It is used to prevent iron-deficiency anemia.

ingredients.name: Ferrous Sulfate
ingredients.summary: Ferrous sulfate is a type of iron supplement used to treat or prevent low blood levels of iron.
ingredients.details: It is commonly added to foods as a fortifying agent to help prevent iron deficiency.

ingredients.name: Thiamine Mononitrate
ingredients.summary: Thiamine mononitrate is a form of vitamin B1 used to fortify foods.
ingredients.details: Vitamin B1 is essential for energy metabolism and nerve function. It is often added to processed foods to enhance nutritional value.

ingredients.name: Riboflavin
ingredients.summary: Riboflavin, or vitamin B2, is a vitamin that helps the body break down carbohydrates, proteins, and fats.
ingredients.details: It is important for body growth and red blood cell production. Riboflavin is often added to foods to fortify them.

ingredients.name: Folic Acid
ingredients.summary: Folic acid is a form of vitamin B9 used to fortify foods.
ingredients.details: It is crucial for DNA synthesis and repair, and is especially important during periods of rapid growth such as pregnancy and infancy.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.summary: Water is a universal solvent and essential for life.
ingredients.details: It is used in food products as a solvent and to adjust texture and consistency. Water is safe and necessary for hydration.

ingredients.name: High Fructose Corn Syrup
ingredients.summary: High fructose corn syrup is a sweetener made from corn starch.
ingredients.details: It is linked to obesity and metabolic disorders due to its high fructose content, which can lead to increased fat accumulation and insulin resistance.

ingredients.name: Palm Oil
ingredients.summary: Palm oil is a type of vegetable oil derived from the fruit of oil palms.
ingredients.details: While it is high in saturated fats, which can raise cholesterol levels, it is also a major contributor to deforestation and habitat destruction.

ingredients.name: Corn Syrup
ingredients.summary: Corn syrup is a sweetener made from corn starch.
ingredients.details: It is used to soften texture, add volume, and prevent crystallization of sugar. Excessive consumption can contribute to health issues similar to those caused by sugar.

ingredients.name: Cocoa
ingredients.summary: Cocoa is a powder made from roasted and ground cacao seeds.
ingredients.details: It is used to add chocolate flavor to foods and is rich in antioxidants. Cocoa is generally considered safe and beneficial in moderation.

ingredients.name: Tallow
ingredients.summary: Tallow is a rendered form of beef or mutton fat.
ingredients.details: It is used in cooking and baking for its flavor and texture. High in saturated fats, it should be consumed in moderation to avoid cardiovascular risks.

ingredients.name: Soybean Oil
ingredients.summary: Soybean oil is a vegetable oil extracted from the seeds of soybeans.
ingredients.details: It is commonly used in cooking and processed foods. It contains polyunsaturated fats, which are considered heart-healthy.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.summary: Glycerin is a sugar alcohol used as a sweetener and humectant.
ingredients.details: It helps retain moisture in foods and is generally recognized as safe. Glycerin is also used in pharmaceuticals and cosmetics.

ingredients.name: Cocoa Processed with Alkali
ingredients.summary: Cocoa processed with alkali, also known as Dutch-processed cocoa, has a milder flavor and darker color.
ingredients.details: The alkalization process reduces acidity and enhances solubility. It is safe for consumption and commonly used in baking.

ingredients.name: Food Starch Modified
ingredients.summary: Modified food starch is starch that has been chemically altered to improve its properties.
ingredients.details: It is used as a thickener, stabilizer, or emulsifier in foods. It is generally considered safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Corn Starch
ingredients.summary: Corn starch is a carbohydrate extracted from the endosperm of corn.
ingredients.details: It is used as a thickening agent in cooking and baking. Corn starch is safe for most people, but those with corn allergies should avoid it.

ingredients.name: Baking Soda
ingredients.summary: Baking soda, or sodium bicarbonate, is a leavening agent used in baking.
ingredients.details: It helps dough rise by releasing carbon dioxide when combined with an acid. Baking soda is safe for consumption in typical culinary uses.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.summary: Salt is a mineral composed primarily of sodium chloride, used to enhance flavor.
ingredients.details: Excessive salt intake can lead to high blood pressure and increased risk of heart disease. It is important to monitor salt consumption.

ingredients.name: Whey
ingredients.summary: Whey is a byproduct of cheese production, rich in protein.
ingredients.details: It is used in food products to improve texture and nutritional content. Whey is safe for most people but should be avoided by those with dairy allergies.

ingredients.name: Corn Syrup Solids
ingredients.summary: Corn syrup solids are dehydrated corn syrup used as a sweetener.
ingredients.details: They are used to add sweetness and texture to foods. Like other sweeteners, they should be consumed in moderation to avoid health issues.

ingredients.name: Calcium Sulfate
ingredients.summary: Calcium sulfate is a food additive used as a firming agent and dough conditioner.
ingredients.details: It is generally recognized as safe and is also used in plaster and drywall. In food, it helps maintain texture and stability.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.summary: Eggs are a common ingredient used for their binding and leavening properties.
ingredients.details: They are a rich source of protein and nutrients but are a common allergen. People with egg allergies should avoid them.

ingredients.name: Agave Syrup
ingredients.summary: Agave syrup is a sweetener derived from the agave plant.
ingredients.details: It has a high fructose content, which can affect blood sugar levels and metabolism. It should be consumed in moderation.

ingredients.name: Inulin
ingredients.summary: Inulin is a type of soluble fiber found in many plants.
ingredients.details: It is used to improve digestive health and as a prebiotic. Inulin is generally safe and beneficial for gut health.

ingredients.name: Egg Whites
ingredients.summary: Egg whites are the clear liquid contained within an egg, used for their protein content.
ingredients.details: They are low in calories and fat, making them a healthy choice for many diets. However, they can trigger allergies in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Dextrose
ingredients.summary: Dextrose is a form of glucose used as a sweetener.
ingredients.details: It is a simple sugar that can rapidly increase blood sugar levels. It should be consumed in moderation, especially by those with diabetes.

ingredients.name: Hydrogenated Tallow
ingredients.summary: Hydrogenated tallow is animal fat that has been chemically altered to be solid at room temperature.
ingredients.details: The hydrogenation process creates trans fats, which are associated with increased risk of heart disease. It is advisable to avoid trans fats when possible.

ingredients.name: Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate
ingredients.summary: Sodium acid pyrophosphate is a leavening agent used in baking.
ingredients.details: It is generally recognized as safe but can contribute to high sodium intake. It is used to control the pH and improve texture in baked goods.

ingredients.name: Mono and Diglycerides
ingredients.summary: Mono and diglycerides are emulsifiers used to blend ingredients that normally don't mix well.
ingredients.details: They are derived from fats and are used to improve texture and extend shelf life. They are generally considered safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Polysorbate 60
ingredients.summary: Polysorbate 60 is an emulsifier used to stabilize and thicken foods.
ingredients.details: While generally recognized as safe, some studies suggest it may affect gut health. It is used in a variety of processed foods.

ingredients.name: Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate
ingredients.summary: Sodium stearoyl lactylate is an emulsifier used to improve dough strength and texture.
ingredients.details: It is commonly used in baked goods and is generally recognized as safe. It helps improve the shelf life and quality of products.

ingredients.name: Cottonseed Oil
ingredients.summary: Cottonseed oil is a vegetable oil extracted from the seeds of cotton plants.
ingredients.details: It is often used in processed foods and may contain pesticide residues. It is high in omega-6 fatty acids, which should be balanced with omega-3 intake.

ingredients.name: Soy Lecithin
ingredients.summary: Soy lecithin is an emulsifier derived from soybeans.
ingredients.details: It is used to stabilize and blend ingredients in food products. It is generally considered safe, but those with soy allergies should be cautious.

ingredients.name: Xanthan Gum
ingredients.summary: Xanthan gum is a thickening and stabilizing agent used in food products.
ingredients.details: It is produced by fermenting sugar with a specific bacteria and is safe for most people. It helps improve texture and consistency in foods.

ingredients.name: Agar
ingredients.summary: Agar is a gelatinous substance derived from seaweed, used as a thickener.
ingredients.details: It is a vegetarian alternative to gelatin and is used in a variety of food products. Agar is safe and often used in desserts and jellies.

ingredients.name: Cellulose Gum
ingredients.summary: Cellulose gum is a thickening agent derived from cellulose, a natural component of plant cell walls.
ingredients.details: It is used to improve texture and stability in food products and is generally recognized as safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Natural and Artificial Flavors
ingredients.summary: Natural and artificial flavors are used to enhance the taste of food products.
ingredients.details: While natural flavors are derived from natural sources, artificial flavors are chemically synthesized. Both are generally safe but can cause allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Color
ingredients.summary: Color additives are used to enhance the appearance of food products.
ingredients.details: Some artificial colors have been linked to health concerns, including hyperactivity in children. It is important to be aware of specific color additives used.

ingredients.name: Monocalcium Phosphate
ingredients.summary: Monocalcium phosphate is a leavening agent used in baking.
ingredients.details: It helps dough rise and is generally recognized as safe. It is commonly used in baking powders and self-rising flours.

ingredients.name: Enzymes
ingredients.summary: Enzymes are proteins that catalyze biochemical reactions, used in food processing.
ingredients.details: They are used to improve texture, flavor, and shelf life of food products. Enzymes are generally considered safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Locust Bean Gum
ingredients.summary: Locust bean gum is a thickening agent derived from the seeds of the carob tree.
ingredients.details: It is used to improve texture and stability in food products and is generally recognized as safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Dipotassium Phosphate
ingredients.summary: Dipotassium phosphate is a food additive used as an emulsifier and stabilizer.
ingredients.details: While generally recognized as safe, excessive intake can contribute to high phosphate levels, which may affect kidney function.

ingredients.name: Chocolate Liquor
ingredients.summary: Chocolate liquor is a pure cocoa mass in solid or semi-solid form.
ingredients.details: It is used as a base for chocolate products and is rich in cocoa solids and cocoa butter. Chocolate liquor is safe and enjoyed for its rich flavor.

ingredients.name: Defatted Soy Flour
ingredients.summary: Defatted soy flour is made from soybeans with most of the oil removed.
ingredients.details: It is high in protein and used to improve the nutritional content of food products. It is safe for most people but should be avoided by those with soy allergies.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.summary: Water is a universal solvent used in skincare products.
ingredients.details: Water is used as a base in many skincare formulations to dissolve other ingredients and provide hydration.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.summary: Glycerin is a humectant that attracts moisture to the skin.
ingredients.details: Glycerin helps to keep the skin hydrated by drawing moisture from the air into the skin's outer layer.

ingredients.name: Myristic Acid
ingredients.summary: Myristic Acid is a fatty acid used as a cleansing agent.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is often used in soaps and cleansers for its ability to help remove dirt and oils from the skin.

ingredients.name: Palmitic Acid
ingredients.summary: Palmitic Acid is a fatty acid used as an emollient.
ingredients.details: It helps to soften and smooth the skin, often used in moisturizers and creams.

ingredients.name: Potassium Hydroxide
ingredients.summary: Potassium Hydroxide is used to adjust pH levels in skincare products.
ingredients.details: While it helps to balance the pH of products, it can be irritating to the skin in high concentrations.

ingredients.name: Glycol Distearate
ingredients.summary: Glycol Distearate is used as an emulsifier and opacifier.
ingredients.details: It helps to stabilize formulations and give products a pearlescent appearance.

ingredients.name: Dipropylene Glycol
ingredients.summary: Dipropylene Glycol is a solvent and viscosity-decreasing agent.
ingredients.details: It is used to improve the texture and spreadability of skincare products.

ingredients.name: Sorbitol
ingredients.summary: Sorbitol is a sugar alcohol used as a humectant.
ingredients.details: It helps to retain moisture in the skin, similar to glycerin.

ingredients.name: Lauric Acid
ingredients.summary: Lauric Acid is a fatty acid used for its cleansing properties.
ingredients.details: It is effective in removing oils and dirt from the skin, commonly found in soaps.

ingredients.name: Stearic Acid
ingredients.summary: Stearic Acid is a fatty acid used as an emulsifier and thickener.
ingredients.details: It helps to stabilize formulations and improve texture in creams and lotions.

ingredients.name: Lauryl Betaine
ingredients.summary: Lauryl Betaine is a mild surfactant used in cleansing products.
ingredients.details: It is often used to reduce irritation potential in cleansers and shampoos.

ingredients.name: Glyceryl Stearate SE
ingredients.summary: Glyceryl Stearate SE is an emulsifier that helps blend oil and water.
ingredients.details: It is used to create a stable formulation in creams and lotions.

ingredients.name: Synthetic Wax
ingredients.summary: Synthetic Wax is used to provide texture and stability to products.
ingredients.details: It helps to thicken formulations and improve the feel of the product on the skin.

ingredients.name: Myristyl Betaine
ingredients.summary: Myristyl Betaine is a surfactant used for its cleansing properties.
ingredients.details: It is used to help cleanse the skin without causing irritation.

ingredients.name: Isopropanol
ingredients.summary: Isopropanol is a type of alcohol used as a solvent.
ingredients.details: While effective in dissolving ingredients, it can be drying to the skin with frequent use.

ingredients.name: Sodium Metabisulfite
ingredients.summary: Sodium Metabisulfite is a preservative used to prevent oxidation.
ingredients.details: It can cause allergic reactions in some individuals, especially those with sulfite sensitivity.

ingredients.name: Disodium EDTA
ingredients.summary: Disodium EDTA is a chelating agent that improves product stability.
ingredients.details: It binds to metal ions to prevent them from affecting the stability and appearance of the product.

ingredients.name: Bis-Ethoxydiglycol Cyclohexane 1,4-Dicarboxylate
ingredients.summary: This compound is used as a film-former and conditioning agent.
ingredients.details: It helps to create a smooth, even layer on the skin, enhancing the feel of the product.

ingredients.name: Acetylated Sodium Hyaluronate
ingredients.summary: Acetylated Sodium Hyaluronate is a modified form of hyaluronic acid.
ingredients.details: It provides enhanced moisture retention and skin conditioning properties.

ingredients.name: Silk Protein
ingredients.summary: Silk Protein is used for its moisturizing and conditioning properties.
ingredients.details: It helps to improve skin texture and hydration by forming a protective barrier.

ingredients.name: Butylated Hydroxytoluene (BHT)
ingredients.summary: BHT is an antioxidant used to prevent product spoilage.
ingredients.details: While effective in preserving products, there are concerns about its potential as a skin irritant and its long-term health effects.

ingredients.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
ingredients.summary: Sodium Hyaluronate is a salt form of hyaluronic acid used for hydration.
ingredients.details: It penetrates the skin to provide deep hydration and improve elasticity.

ingredients.name: Potassium Sorbate
ingredients.summary: Potassium Sorbate is a preservative used to inhibit microbial growth.
ingredients.details: It is commonly used in cosmetics to extend shelf life and maintain product integrity.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.summary: Citric Acid is used to adjust the pH of skincare products.
ingredients.details: It helps to maintain the acidity of products, ensuring they remain effective and safe for use.

ingredients.name: Tocopherol
ingredients.summary: Tocopherol is a form of Vitamin E used as an antioxidant.
ingredients.details: It helps to protect the skin from free radical damage and improve moisture retention.

ingredients.name: Glicerina

ingredients.name: Ácido mirístico
ingredients.summary: El ácido mirístico es un ácido graso utilizado como emulsionante.
ingredients.details: Se encuentra comúnmente en productos de cuidado personal para ayudar a mezclar ingredientes a base de agua y aceite.

ingredients.name: Ácido palmítico
ingredients.summary: El ácido palmítico es un ácido graso que actúa como emoliente.
ingredients.details: Ayuda a suavizar y acondicionar la piel, mejorando su textura.

ingredients.name: Hidróxido de potasio
ingredients.summary: El hidróxido de potasio se utiliza para ajustar el pH de los productos.
ingredients.details: Puede ser irritante para la piel en concentraciones altas, pero es seguro en las cantidades típicas utilizadas en cosméticos.

ingredients.name: Esterato de glicol disteárico
ingredients.summary: Es un emulsionante que ayuda a estabilizar las mezclas de agua y aceite.

ingredients.name: Dipropilenglicol
ingredients.summary: El dipropilenglicol es un solvente y humectante utilizado en cosméticos.
ingredients.details: Ayuda a disolver otros ingredientes y a mantener la humedad en la piel.

ingredients.name: Sorbitol
ingredients.summary: El sorbitol es un humectante que atrae la humedad a la piel.
ingredients.details: Se utiliza para mejorar la hidratación y la textura de los productos cosméticos.

ingredients.name: Ácido láurico
ingredients.summary: El ácido láurico es un ácido graso utilizado como agente limpiador.
ingredients.details: Tiene propiedades antimicrobianas y se utiliza en productos de limpieza y cuidado de la piel.

ingredients.name: Ácido esteárico
ingredients.summary: El ácido esteárico es un ácido graso que actúa como emulsionante y estabilizador.
ingredients.details: Ayuda a mantener la consistencia de las emulsiones en productos de cuidado personal.

ingredients.name: Cocamidopropil betaína
ingredients.summary: Es un surfactante suave utilizado en productos de limpieza.
ingredients.details: Puede causar irritación en pieles sensibles, pero es generalmente seguro en productos cosméticos.

ingredients.name: Estearato de glicerilo SE
ingredients.summary: Es un emulsionante que ayuda a mezclar ingredientes a base de agua y aceite.
ingredients.details: Proporciona estabilidad a las emulsiones en productos cosméticos.

ingredients.name: Cera sintética
ingredients.summary: La cera sintética se utiliza para proporcionar textura y consistencia a los productos.
ingredients.details: Ayuda a espesar y estabilizar las formulaciones cosméticas.

ingredients.name: Miristamidopropil betaína
ingredients.summary: Es un surfactante suave utilizado para limpiar la piel.
ingredients.details: Ayuda a eliminar la suciedad y el aceite sin irritar la piel.

ingredients.name: Policuaternio-7
ingredients.summary: Es un acondicionador utilizado en productos para el cabello y la piel.
ingredients.details: Ayuda a mejorar la suavidad y manejabilidad del cabello.

ingredients.name: Benzoato de sodio
ingredients.summary: Es un conservante utilizado para prevenir el crecimiento microbiano.

ingredients.name: Cloruro de sodio
ingredients.summary: El cloruro de sodio se utiliza como agente espesante y estabilizador.

ingredients.name: Fragancia

ingredients.name: Cocamidopropil betaína

ingredients.name: Isopropanol
ingredients.summary: Es un alcohol utilizado como solvente y agente de secado.

ingredients.name: Metabisulfito de sodio
ingredients.summary: Es un conservante que previene el deterioro del producto.
ingredients.details: Puede causar reacciones alérgicas en personas sensibles a los sulfitos.

ingredients.name: EDTA disódico
ingredients.summary: Es un agente quelante que mejora la estabilidad del producto.
ingredients.details: Ayuda a prevenir la degradación de los ingredientes activos en las formulaciones cosméticas.

ingredients.name: Bis-etoxidiglicol ciclohexano 1,4-dicarboxilato
ingredients.summary: Es un emoliente utilizado para suavizar la piel.
ingredients.details: Proporciona una sensación sedosa y mejora la aplicación de productos cosméticos.

ingredients.name: Hialuronato de sodio acetilado

ingredients.name: Proteína de seda

ingredients.name: Butilhidroxitolueno (BHT)

ingredients.name: Hialuronato de sodio

ingredients.name: Tocoferol

ingredients.name: Rice Hulls

ingredients.name: Starch

ingredients.details: Commonly derived from corn, potatoes, or wheat, starch is used to thicken sauces and soups. It is a staple ingredient in many diets and is generally considered safe.

ingredients.name: Rice Blend Extract
ingredients.summary: Rice Blend Extract is a concentrated form of rice used for flavor or nutritional purposes.
ingredients.details: This extract can be used to enhance the flavor or nutritional profile of food products. It is safe for consumption and often used in health-focused food items.
